transcript.text: From what you have described, the most likely cause is unbalanced / uneven load. Does it keep turning slowly backwards and forwards as if trying to balance the load, and does it spin fine with a different, evenly-spread load?
yeah it sloshes back n forth, tries to speed up then slows down a few times then gives up. only had the big rubber backed bath mat in on its own tho, full load yesterday spun fine

This sounds like normal behaviour rather than a fault: Machines deliberately skip or reduce the spin when a load is unbalanced (one heavy item, a small load, a duvet or a bath mat). Clothes then come out wet. It would only be worth a closer look if it never spins even with a normal mixed load, or it hums without draining. Does that match what you are seeing?
